target_format: P2WSH v0; witness script OP_2 <keyA> <keyB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG; two cosigners, each a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic whose entropy is a cut range of the genesis block raw hex, hashed (SHA-256, first 32 hex digits as raw entropy via Ian Coleman's tool), with a BIP39 passphrase, derived at BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/2'

derivation.summary: cut -b N-M on the lowercase genesis raw-block hex (570 hex chars), sha256sum the cut text, first 32 hex digits of the digest as raw entropy in Ian Coleman's BIP39 tool (Entropy Type Hex), 12 English words, BIP39 passphrase, BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/2' for each of two cosigners; build the 2-of-2 witness script, sha256, compare with the published witness program
derivation.certified_against: the BIP-173 P2WSH test vector, and a real 2-of-2 P2WSH spent in block 963629 (tx 47ded3504e855ce418e46eeca4694b55a623d1e23a8e3c83292abbcf9cee9f7a, input 0) whose revealed keys rebuild the script and hash to the spent address; private key 1 to the generator point; negative control against the escrow

difficulty_note: solved 2026-10-17 by an independent solver after 8 weeks; the GPU key search was not the bottleneck (the solver's own post-sweep OP_RETURN: 'My GPU searched everywhere except the PBKDF2 settings'); the binding insight was the BIP39 passphrase step, for which the author's only public nudge was 'Who received the first transaction?' The exact cut ranges, passphrases and account numbers remain unpublished; the on-chain dialogue (blocks 963629-971896) is the primary record

leads.title: closed: the escrow was swept on 2026-10-17 (tx 1c70c474, 935,266 sats to bc1qdu8mh...); all leads below are historical
ask the author about the passphrase's nature on chain (79-byte draft in the README); pass 3 shows it is none of 53 obvious readings of the block
pass 3 wave 2: text variants and every coinbase-text substring as passphrase
watch the escrow for new OP_RETURN hints or a spend before any work
pass 3: 16-byte genesis windows as 12-word entropy, 53 passphrases, genesis integers as BIP48 account, script types 0/1/2, keys paired (2.46e12 pairs)
pass 2: library-specific roots (hashed roots, raw 64-byte extended key, raw key with zero chain code) along the same 214 paths
pass 1: literal readings of the 2026-08-28 hints, families A to D

solutions.answer: unpublished: the solver's OP_RETURN says the GPU covered the key space and the binding step was the BIP39 PBKDF2 passphrase settings; the author's public hint for the passphrase was 'Who received the first transaction?'; the two cosigner master fingerprints 0852014c and 040e2791 and the cut -b / sha256sum / Ian Coleman Hex procedure were confirmed on chain during the solve dialogue
solutions.payout_amount: 935,266 sats (main sweep, block 971803); later dust sweeps brought the total to 947,620 sats
